function rpcHandleSchema<S>(
  methods,
): ZodPipe<

        { -readonly [P in string | number | symbol]: S[P] },
        {}

Cap'n Web stubs are callable proxies, not records. Select only owner methods and
bind their receiver before the maintained function schemas wrap them.

### rpcMethod()

```ts
function rpcMethod<T>(
  result,
): ZodFunction<
  $ZodFunctionArgs,
  ZodPromise<ZodPipe<ZodUnknown, ZodTransform<Awaited<T>, unknown>>>
>;
```

Wrap an RPC method's result schema into a Zod function schema: the decoded value
resolves on success, and a malformed result is rethrown as a PROTOCOL AppError
after releasing the raw RPC envelope.
